reading_notes: Read from a 500 dpi render of the vector schematic; pin numbers are EPC's symbol pins, which match the datasheet GN pinning (1 OE, 2 A, 3 B, 4 GND, 5 C, 6 D, 7 Y, 8 VCC).
EPC's 74LVC1G99 symbol draws Y = (C ? B : A) XOR D with an active-low output enable, the same function as the datasheet's Table 4.

D620/D625 are drawn with the cathode at the InBuf side and the anode at the R620/C620 (R625/C625) node, so a falling InBuf discharges the capacitor through the diode and only rising edges pass through R620 (R625).
J640 pin 3 has a stub with no net name; it is treated as unconnected, so a jumper across pins 3-4 leaves SWbyp and UseDT at their pull-downs (the QSG's dead-time bypass setting).
The logic gates and U80 share the 5 V VCC net from U100 (MCP1703, 5.0 V); R78 (0 ohm) feeds U80 and R77 (0 ohm, default population) ties the '4.7 V' net to it.

component_values.qsg_dead_time_rule: R(ohm) = 13.5 DT(ns) - 14 (QSG Fig. 4, EPC's own curve; 120 ohm -> 9.9 ns, referenced to the driver input); QSG recommends 5-15 ns

not_transcribed: C70/C75 (empty), R70/R75 series values are not used by the static evaluation; the PWM source's own levels and edges are outside the board.
